# NaamRas

> NaamRas is a Sikh scripture reading app for daily Gurbani reading, reflection, saved passages, and curated books.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://naamras.xyz/)
- [Read and search](https://naamras.xyz/banis)
- [Panth Prakash](https://naamras.xyz/library/panth-prakash-english)
- [Support](https://naamras.xyz/support)
- [Privacy and sources](https://naamras.xyz/privacy)

## Notes

- Gurbani search and reader views identify their scripture source and location.
- Saved items and reading progress remain on the device unless the reader enables cloud backup.
- Public share links open the corresponding Hukamnama or personal reading inside NaamRas.
